subject.title: Feishu Bitable write operations return 400 after bot/app replacement

question: For Feishu Bitable table operations after bot/app replacement, should OpenClaw keep app-credential behavior with clearer setup diagnostics, add an explicit user-auth path, or route this under the broader bound-account precedence work?
rationale: The current code path is clear, but the observed Feishu 400 does not identify whether the product should change auth behavior, account precedence, or diagnostics; that choice affects credentials and tenant boundaries.

options.title: Require Live Feishu Error First
options.body: Keep the issue open and require the exact Feishu response body/code/log_id before choosing diagnostics, user auth, or routing precedence work.

options.title: Sponsor User-Auth Design
options.body: If Feishu confirms table writes need user authorization after app replacement, design an explicit plugin-owned user-token path with storage, setup, and docs.

options.title: Fold Into Bound-Account Work
options.body: If the evidence matches non-inbound wrong-account routing, make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/96657 the canonical implementation path.

recommendation.title: Require Live Feishu Error First
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and require the exact Feishu response body/code/log_id before choosing diagnostics, user auth, or routing precedence work.
